The Duo Auth API is a low-level, RESTful API for adding strong
two-factor authentication to your website or application. Check
out the Duo Two-Factor Authentication API for Applications
Solution Guide for an Auth API tutorial.
Action required by March 31, 2026 - Duo CA bundle expiration
Duo’s existing certificate authority (CA) pinning bundle will expire in
2026. Duo products that use certificate pinning require a software update
for uninterrupted use after February 2, 2026. The final cutoff for legacy
clients is March 31, 2026.
Please visit Duo Knowledge Base article 9451 for more information and
guidance for your deployed Duo Auth API applications.
